anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss activity, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is functioning correctly and generating opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and system integration to ensure active trading is occurring as expected.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and take steps to mitigate it.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to diagnose and resolve the lack of learning cycles and opportunity generation.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity can hinder the platform's ability to adapt and optimize trading strategies, impacting profitability.

recommendations.action: Analyze trading logs and strategy configurations to identify why there are no active trades and address any issues.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring active trading is crucial for platform revenue and user satisfaction.
